rendered:
According to Fig. 4a, the TGA-DTG curves for the recovered NMC622 show two components being burned off:

1. An organic coating layer (~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C)
2. Carbon black (CB) (~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C)

Calcination at 600 °C in air removes both the organic coating layer and CB.
